scenes.title: 1947 Harlem / Springfield Testing Table: Kenneth & Mamie Phipps Clark Presenting the Four Identical Matched Dolls & 8-Question Protocol
scenes.era: 1947, Northside Center for Child Development, New York (Clark & Clark Doll Study)

layout.description: Warm, sunlit high-key 1947 child-development consultation room with a low child-height oak table displaying **four identical 12-inch sculpted matte-porcelain dolls** (two warm-brown-toned, two pale-ivory-toned, wearing identical crisp white cloth diapers/rompers with identical smiling features), Kenneth & Mamie Clark's **8-Question Protocol Sheet**, and a historical framed placard of **1954 *Brown v. Board* Footnote 11 (67% / 59% Data)**.

positions.who: Mamie Phipps Clark (mannequin in 1947 tailored blazer, collared blouse, and skirt)
positions.where: seated warmly at child-eye level across the low oak table gently arranging the four matched dolls in balanced order

positions.who: Kenneth B. Clark (mannequin in 1947 double-breasted wool suit, tie, and horn-rim spectacles)
positions.where: standing calmly beside the table recording responses across Questions 1 through 8 alongside the 253-child summary chart

positions.who: 5-year-old Child mannequin (in neat 1947 pleated jumper / overalls)
positions.where: looking thoughtfully across the four otherwise-identical dolls during the calm structured choices

props.name: four identical 12-inch dolls differing ONLY in brown vs ivory skin/hair tone
props.period_detail: custom-matched by the Clarks so clothing, size, and expression were 100% identical
props.physical_behavior: historic centerpiece preserved today at the Smithsonian National Museum

props.name: 8-Question Protocol & '94% Accurate ID | 67% Play Preference' Summary Ledger
props.period_detail: proves crystal-clear racial knowledge paired with absorbed societal hierarchy
props.physical_behavior: the exact dataset cited in Footnote 11 of Brown v. Board

actions.verb_sequence: places all four matched dolls evenly on the sunlit low oak table and asks the calm identification and preference sequence -> Child demonstrates 94% accurate category knowledge before hesitating between societal preference cues and Request 8 ('looks like you')
compiles the 253-child dataset into the NAACP social-science brief for Thurgood Marshall

reactions.reaction: respond with gentle, supportive warmth to every child before turning the data toward structural school reform

scenes.wardrobe: 1947 dignified professional attire: tailored women's suit blazer and blouse; classic men's wool suit and tie; neat 1947 child's collared shirt and jumper.
scenes.lighting: Warm, respectful high-key morning window daylight.
scenes.recognition_hook: Four identical twelve-inch dolls differing only in color exposed what segregation was teaching five-year-olds — and walked straight into Footnote 11 of the U.S. Supreme Court.

key_visual.description: a sunlit 1947 child-development room where Mamie and Kenneth Clark sit at a low oak table displaying four identical brown and ivory dolls beside a seated child and an 8-question summary chart
